---
description: Generate a Git commit message that adheres to the repository's formatting requirements.
name: commit
---

Generate a commit message for the currently staged changes or the provided implementation details.
Follow these requirements STRICTLY:
1. The commit subject/title MUST be a maximum of 50 characters.
2. The commit description MUST wrap at 62 characters per line.
3. No need for a big description for commits. Just the essential details. Keep it very concise.
4. Follow conventional commits (e.g., feat:, fix:, chore:).
